about: The hero's company row (UI-5; Darko 2026-11-28: each company's own mark in its own colour, larger than its name, no card). Every mark here is the company's own published file, unchanged, except where `derived` says how. A company whose terms want approval first, or that publishes no mark, is its name in plain text (`text`). Fetched 2026-11-28.

row.name: ChatGPT
row.terms: OpenAI's brand page: "By using our logos, you agree to our Marks usage terms"; use it "exactly as provided", don't "add any colors to the Blossom", don't imply endorsement, don't feature it "more prominently than your own company's name or marks".

row.name: Claude
row.text: Anthropic's trademark guidelines (https://www.anthropic.com/legal/trademark-guidelines): "You may only use our trademarks as specifically permitted by us and only in materials we approve beforehand." The Claude Spark (press kit, Clay #D97757) waits on marketing@anthropic.com.

row.name: Gemini
row.text: Google's Partner Marketing Hub: a product icon needs an account and its approval form; for "works with" it says "Use plain text". No official download outside the hub's login.

row.name: Meta AI
row.text: Meta publishes no Meta AI brand guidelines or download (https://www.meta.com/brand/resources/), and "You may only use our trademarks with our permission".

row.name: Dearest
row.source: https://dearest.app/android-chrome-512x512.png (the site's own logo, its Organization schema's), sha256 7b940ed35b9ef641efbbf49450422fe2be447a4df626ae9c2e9396e9f5ee2d96

row.terms: https://dearest.app/terms (2026-02-13) has no trademark or logo clause.
